title: Economy tuning
description: Gold and XP rewards owned by the Economy domain (Economy & Progression Bible §1–§8; ADR-011 §11, §17): starting and passive Gold, what lane Fluxborn, Vanguard kills and structures pay, the Team Flux farm bonus, and who is near enough to share. VeyraEconomy binds it to FVeyraEconomyTuning. The XP curve stays in Progression.json.

perFluxborn.description: A value for each kind of Fluxborn, keyed by its ID in World.json fluxborn.units.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

starting.description: Every participant's one guaranteed grant, when the match prepares (§1, §10).

fluxborn.description: Each kind's listed Gold: all of it to the Vanguard who lands the last hit (§3.1).

participationFraction.description: The share of a Fluxborn's Gold each other nearby living ally gets when an allied Vanguard damaged it recently (§3.2: 10%).

vanguardKill.description: A Vanguard's base kill Gold, whatever its level (§5.1).

assistPoolFraction.description: The Assist Gold pool, as a fraction of the base kill Gold, split among the assisters (§5.1: 50%).

firstBloodFraction.description: The match's first kill adds this fraction of the base kill Gold for the killer (§5.2: 50%).

structurePool.description: A lane Spire's or base-defense tower's Gold, split among its recent contributors (§8.1).

firstStructureBonus.description: The first Spire or base tower to fall adds this for every member of the destroying team (§8.1).

wildlife.description: Each species of wildlife's Gold, keyed by its ID in World.json wildlife.species: all of it to the Vanguard credited with the creature's kill (§7).

fluxWellPool.description: A secured Flux Well's pool, split evenly among the capturers present at that moment (§8.2: about one large creature's Gold).

passiveGold.description: Passive Gold (author ruling 2026-09-28, amending §1): every participant earns a steady income while the match is live, dead or alive, as in League of Legends. There is still no passive XP.

perPayment.description: The Gold each participant receives at each payment (the author's ruling: 15 every 10 seconds, 90 a minute).

intervalSeconds.description: How often it is paid, in seconds of live match.

startSeconds.description: How long after the match goes live the income begins, in seconds (League starts it as the first minions spawn).

fluxborn.description: Each kind's base XP for the nearby living allies (§3.3).

wildlife.description: Each species of wildlife's base XP for the killing team's nearby living Vanguards (§7).

sharedPoolFraction.description: With two or more to share, one pool of this much of the base XP split equally (§3.3: 120%).

killBase.description: A level-1 victim's base kill XP (§6).

killPerLevel.description: Base kill XP added for each level of the victim above 1.

participantBonus.description: The kill XP pool grows by this much of the base for each qualifying participant after the first (§6: 20%).

higherLevelVictimMultiplier.description: Applied once to the pool when the victim outlevels the killer (§6).

fluxBonus.description: Enemy Fluxborn strengthened by Team Flux pay a little more (§4).

fluxPerStep.description: Each this much of the Fluxborn's team's active Flux adds a step (§4: 25).

bonusPerStep.description: The Gold and XP each step adds (§4: 1%).

eligibility.description: Who is near enough, and recent enough, to share (§2, §3, §8).

radius.description: How near a death a Vanguard must be for farm XP, participation Gold and kill XP, in units; walls and fog never block it (§2).

fluxbornParticipationSeconds.description: How recently an allied Vanguard must have damaged a Fluxborn for nearby allies to share its Gold (§3.2).

structureContributionSeconds.description: How recently a Vanguard must have damaged a structure to share its pool (§8.1).
